title: 第十二章 用之有弗盈
content_zh:
“道冲，而用之有弗盈也。渊呵！似万物之宗。锉其兑，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。湛呵！似或存。吾不知其谁之子，象帝之先。”
讲经的老道士声音极轻，但却清楚映入经院每一个听讲的人耳中。当他讲完最后一个字，眉眼忽然耷拉了下来，仿佛下一刻就要睡去，整一个风烛残年的样子。
姜望不敢怠慢，跟着师兄们恭恭敬敬地行了礼，才起身离座。
别看这位老人不起眼的样子，其人却是枫林城道院副院长，宋其方。更准确的说，在董阿来之前，他才是枫林城道院的正院长，在枫林城扎根已有数十年。只是已逾八十之龄，修为却始终在七品境踏步，迟迟无法业上。故而颇得爱戴。
董阿来了之后，他也不争不抢，全力配合，让董阿得以顺利掌控枫林城道院。作为回报，董阿也给予了他极高的尊重。
在整个枫林城，以德高望重而论，也无人能超过宋其方了。
一直到走出经院大门，姜望的心都没能平静，而是沉浸在一种巨大的感慨中。
道是什么？看不见摸不着，却无所不在，无穷无尽。要怎么认识它，了解它，追求它？越是追求、越是了解，越是认识，就越觉得自己无知，觉得自己渺小。
只能叹一声“渊呵！”，深远啊！

凌河且行且诵，恨不得反复咀嚼。赵汝成虽然向来不是很重视课业，却也若有所思。唯有杜野虎哈欠连天，倒像是刚补了个觉。
每期内院选生十人，仅以基础吐纳法而论，杜野虎的进度仅在已经提前道脉外显的姜望之后，不得不说天赋异禀。可那些所谓的大道经典，他是实在听不进去。与之相反，一到术法之类的课，他立刻就生龙活虎了。
内门才算是真正的道院，这话一点不假。当初在外门，只有一些简单的武技传授，隔一段时间才会有内门师兄过来统一做一番指点。而拜入内门之后，五天便有一次经课，旬日便有一次法课。前者学经，后者习术。都是由资深道者授课。而平日里若是有什么修行疑难，也可随时向师长们请教。那些在外门时需以贡献换取的武技，也都无限制对内门弟子开放。
只是对于道院内门弟子来说，并无太大吸引力罢了。倒不是说武道就不强，而是整个庄国修行界，都是以道门修行法为主。枫林城道院纵是收集了一些武技，却只是作为外门弟子时期的一个过渡补充，自然强不到哪里去，更是远远不如道术的威能了，是以也没什么人会舍近求远。
“姜师兄留步！”一个声音在身后响起。
姜望回过头去，认出来是同期入选内门的方鹤翎——其人出身枫林城三大姓，方鹏举正是他的堂兄。
说起来他本没有资格入选城道院内门，但是每期的内院选生，三大姓必要占据一个名额。这几乎已是默认的规则。方鹏举入选自然是名正言顺，方鹤翎的话，就不知方家暗地里付出什么代价了。
这很现实，修行虽然是一条超凡之路，但这个世上，只要是人走的路，就永远少不了错综复杂的关系，永远没有那么纯粹。即使是枫林城道院，也不能例外。
“有事？”姜望淡淡发问。
“哎，也没什么事。”方鹤翎一身月白长袍，拱了拱手，倒显得有几分翩翩风度，“就是为方鹏举的狼子野心给你道个歉，他已经被革出家谱，我方家没有这样不仁不义的人。”

“他是他，你是你。你没有必要替他道歉，他做的事情也与你无关。”
姜望说完便走，他实在没心情陪这种公子哥作秀。
但方鹤翎显然觉得他被侮辱了，想他堂堂枫林城三大姓的出身，亲自给姜望这么一个破落户出身的人道歉，姜望不说感激涕零，至少也得执手相看，惺惺相惜吧？怎么却是这样一副冷淡的样子呢？
“姜师兄着什么急啊？”方鹤翎紧赶几步，绕到姜望一行人前面，带着笑道：“忘了跟姜师兄说，不才昨日刚服下开脉丹，已然道脉外显。”
他尽量克制，但那种得意仍然呼之欲出。
“然后呢？”姜望问。
方鹤翎愣了一下，才道：“本期内院选生，唯有我们二人提前道脉外显，正应该多多亲近才是。”
到底是年龄小，尽管自小受到的教导令他保持着礼仪，但话里话外，已经是目无余子了。所谓天下英雄，唯你我二人也。
他倒是真不为方鹏举的死记恨姜望，方鹏举不死，他还没有如今的机会呢！若不是为了不堕堂堂三大姓的声威，保住枫林城道院内院选生的名额，即使他父亲隐隐已经是方家下任族长，也很难说服家族花偌大代价买来开脉丹。
那样他进入内门就要等到明年了，或者明年也不一定能进。毕竟一年就十个名额，整个枫林城多少双眼睛盯着？若是家族有比他优秀的其他子弟，他父亲也不能做得太过明显，之前方鹏举提前预定了那个位置就是明证。
“哦。”
姜望哦了一声，便绕开方鹤翎，自顾自往前走了。
他当然知道方鹤翎是方家下任族长的嫡子，三大姓的嫡脉。他也知道方鹤翎至少目前无意与他起什么矛盾，甚至是为了维持方家的名声，其人大概还会与他称兄道弟，一团和气。
可是凭什么？凭什么方鹏举那样优秀的人物，却苦求一颗开脉丹而不得，以至于越来越偏激躁进。而在他死后短短几天，这方鹤翎就拥有了？这方鹤翎什么底细别人不清楚，他们几兄弟还能不清楚吗？
但凡他有那么几分出息，当初方家哪里轮得到方鹏举出头！
就算方鹏举辜恩负义一夕身死，可是仅凭眼前这个不知所谓的公子哥，就有资格践踏他吗？
姜望没有当场发作，已是相当克制。
凌河杜野虎等人，更是从头到尾没有看他一眼。
一行人走开了，只留下方鹤翎站在原地，脸上的笑容慢慢僵硬。
他没想到自己竟然被无视了。

在他吞下开脉丹，一朝外显道脉，直入内门之后，竟仍被无视了！
他想起当初刚进外门时，在道院外遇到这几位外门的头面人物，他兴致勃勃地上前想跟自己堂哥的朋友们打声招呼，认识一下。
他的堂哥却甚至都没有看到他，跟这几个人勾肩搭背地远去了。
那时候的失落他一刻也不曾忘记，所以在开脉巩固后的第一时间，就来到姜望等人面前。
他不知道自己是否想要证明什么，但至少，你们这些人，必须要看我一眼。
然而什么都没有。
明明一切都改变了，却还像什么都不曾改变。
“姜望！”
方鹤翎在心里大喊。
他竭力想要控制好表情，但脸色，已经难看非常。
content_en:
"The road rushes, but there is no surplus when using it. Yuanhao! It seems to be the ancestor of all things. File it, resolve its confusion, harmonize its light, and share its dust. Zhanhao! It seems like it may exist. I don't know whose son it is, the ancestor of Xiang Emperor."
The voice of the old Taoist priest who lectured was very soft, but it was clearly heard in the ears of everyone who listened to the lecture. When he finished speaking the last word, his eyebrows suddenly drooped, as if he was about to fall asleep in the next moment, looking like he was in his twilight years.
Jiang Wang did not dare to be negligent and followed his senior brothers in bowing respectfully before standing up and leaving his seat.
Despite the inconspicuous appearance of this old man, he is actually the deputy dean of Maplewood City Taoist Academy, Song Qifang. To be more precise, before Dong Alai, he was the principal of the Maplewood City Taoist Academy, and he had taken root in Maplewood City for decades. It's just that he is over eighty years old, but his cultivation is still at the seventh level, and he has been unable to advance in his career. Therefore, he is quite popular.
After Dong A arrived, he did not fight or grab, and cooperated fully, allowing Dong A to successfully control the Maple Forest City Taoist Academy. In return, Dong-ah treated him with great respect.
In the entire Maple Forest City, no one could surpass Song Qifang in terms of virtue and respect.
Until he walked out of the scholastic gate, Jiang Wang's heart could not calm down, but he was immersed in a huge emotion.
What is Tao? Invisible and intangible, yet omnipresent and endless. How to recognize it, understand it, and pursue it? The more I pursue, the more I understand, the more I know, the more I feel ignorant and insignificant.
I can only sigh "Abyss!" How profound!

Walking along the river and reciting it, I wish I could chew it over and over again. Although Zhao Rucheng never paid much attention to his studies, he was thoughtful about it. Only Du Yehu yawned profusely, as if he had just caught up on his sleep.
The inner courtyard selects ten students in each period. Based on the basic breathing and breathing method, Du Yehu's progress is only behind Jiang Wang, who has already revealed his Taoist veins in advance. He has to be said to be extremely talented. But he really couldn't listen to those so-called Dao classics. On the contrary, when he came to classes such as magic, he immediately became lively and energetic.
The inner sect is the real Taoist temple, this is absolutely true. At first, there were only some simple martial arts teachings in the outer sect, and after a while, the inner sect brothers would come over and give unified guidance. After worshiping at the inner gate, there will be a sutra class every five days and a Dharma class on the tenth day. The former studied scriptures and the latter practiced martial arts. They are all taught by senior Taoists. And if you have any practice difficulties on weekdays, you can always ask the teachers for advice. Those martial arts skills that need to be exchanged for contributions in the outer sect are also open to the inner sect disciples without restrictions.
It's just that it's not very attractive to the inner disciples of the Taoist Academy. This is not to say that martial arts are not strong, but the entire cultivation world of Zhuang Kingdom is dominated by Taoist cultivation methods. Even though Maplewood City Taoist Academy has collected some martial arts skills, it is only a transitional supplement during the period of outer disciples. Naturally, it is not much stronger, and it is far less powerful than the Taoist skills. Therefore, no one will sacrifice the near for the distant.
"Senior Brother Jiang, stay!" A voice sounded from behind.
Jiang Wang turned around and recognized Fang Heling, who was selected for the inner sect at the same time - he came from one of the three major surnames in Maplewood City, and Fang Pengju was his cousin.
Speaking of which, he was not qualified to be selected into the inner sect of the City Daoyuan, but for each period of inner sect selection, the three major surnames must occupy a quota. This is almost the default rule. Fang Peng's selection was of course justified, but if Fang Heling said it, I don't know what price the Fang family paid secretly.
This is very realistic. Although spiritual practice is an extraordinary path, as long as it is a path that people take in this world, there will always be complicated relationships and it will never be that pure. Even Maplewood City Taoist Academy is no exception.
"Is something wrong?" Jiang Wang asked calmly.
"Hey, it's nothing." Fang Heling, wearing a moon-white robe, cupped her hands, showing herHe must be somewhat personable, "I just want to apologize to you for Fang Pengju's wolfish ambition. He has been expelled from the family tree. There is no such unkind and unjust person in our Fang family."
"He is him, and you are you. You don't need to apologize for him, and what he did has nothing to do with you."
After Jiang Wang finished speaking, he left. He was really not in the mood to show off with such a young man.
But Fang Heling obviously felt that he had been insulted. Thinking of his dignified family background in Maplewood City, he personally apologized to Jiang Wang, a man with a poor family background. Not only did Jiang Wang shed tears of gratitude, he at least had to hold hands and look at each other with sympathy, right? Why do you look so cold?
"Senior Brother Jiang, why are you in a hurry?" Fang Heling hurried a few steps, walked around in front of Jiang Wang and his group, and said with a smile: "I forgot to tell Senior Brother Jiang that I just took the Kaimai Pill yesterday, and my Dao veins are already visible."
He tried his best to restrain himself, but the pride was still coming out.
"Then what?" Jiang Wang asked.
Fang Heling was stunned for a moment and then said: "In this round of inner court selections, we are the only two who have revealed their true origins in advance, so we should be closer to each other."
After all, it was because of his young age. Although he had been taught to maintain etiquette since he was a child, his words were already arrogant. The so-called heroes in the world are just you and me.
He really doesn't hate Jiang Wang for Fang Pengju's death. If Fang Pengju had not died, he wouldn't have the chance he has now! If it weren't for the sake of not losing the prestige of the three major surnames in Tangtang and keeping the quota of candidates in the inner courtyard of Maple Forest City, even though his father was already the next patriarch of the Fang family, it would be difficult to convince the family to spend such a huge price to buy the Pulse Opening Pill.
Then he will have to wait until next year to enter the inner gate, or he may not be able to enter next year. After all, there are only ten places per year. How many pairs of eyes are watching in the entire Maplewood City? If there were other children in the family who were better than him, his father couldn't make it too obvious. Fang Pengju had reserved that position in advance as proof.
"Oh."
Jiang Wang said oh, then bypassed Fang Heling and walked forward on his own.
Of course he knew that Fang Heling was the direct son of the next patriarch of the Fang family and a direct descendant of the three major surnames. He also knew that Fang Heling, at least for now, had no intention of having any conflicts with him. Even in order to maintain the reputation of the Fang family, he would probably become brothers with him and live in harmony.
But why? How come Fang Pengju, an outstanding person like him, couldn't get a pulse-opening pill, so he became more and more aggressive. And just a few days after his death, Fang Heling had this? If others don't know Fang Heling's details, how can they, the brothers?
As long as he has some potential, how could the Fang family get Fang Peng to take the lead in the first place!
Even if Fang Pengju betrayed his kindness and died overnight, does this ignorant young master in front of him have the right to trample on him?
Jiang Wang did not have an attack on the spot and was quite restrained.
Linghe, Du Yehu and others did not even look at him from beginning to end.
The group of people walked away, leaving Fang Heling standing there, the smile on his face slowly stiffening.
He didn't expect that he would be ignored.
After he swallowed the Pulse Opening Pill, revealed his Dao Meridian and entered the inner gate, he was still ignored!
He remembered that when he first entered the outer sect, he met these leading figures of the outer sect outside the Taoist temple. He excitedly stepped forward to say hello and get acquainted with his cousin's friends.
His cousin didn't even see him, and walked away with these people.
He never forgot the loss at that time, so he came to Jiang Wang and others as soon as he opened his pulse and consolidated it.
He doesn't know if he wants to prove anything, but at least, you people, you have to take a look at me.
But there was nothing.
Obviously everything has changed, but it still seems like nothing has changed.
"Jiang Wang!"
Fang Heling shouted in his heart.
He tried his best to control his expression, but his face was already very ugly.
